name: Egyptian koshari bowl
steps: Combine the cooked rice, lentils, and macaroni in a bowl.
Simmer the tinned tomatoes with garlic, cumin, and a pinch of chilli into a sauce.
Fry the sliced onion in oil until deeply crisp and browned.
Spoon the tomato sauce over the rice, lentils, and pasta.
Top with the chickpeas and the crispy fried onions.
